latestVersion.changelog:
**This update introduces a new skill focused on search, recommendation, and launching of games on the Tianyi Cloud Game platform.**

- Skill renamed and re-scoped: Now dedicated to 天翼云游戏 (Tianyi Cloud Game) with specific triggers for game-related intentions.
- Added clear interaction rules: Defines precise, friendly user prompts and prohibits exposing implementation details or internal process language.
- Introduced robust caching strategy: All API queries require pre-checks against a file-based local cache to minimize repeated requests.
- Detailed user intent judgment: Covers scenarios for exact match, recommendations, mixed queries, and follow-up selections with step-by-step handling.
- New PowerShell scripts and caching specs: Detailed, robust instructions provided for normalizing input, caching API responses, and offline cache usage.
- All previous content regarding general cloud storage services has been removed in favor of dedicated game discovery and launching flows on play.cn.
